t: Vivo van and truck first aid kit essential for commercial and personal vehicles. Designed to provide comprehensive first aid on the road, this durable kit includes everything needed to treat minor injuries such as wound cleaning, sanitary handling, and securing dressings, stored in one organised container. Packed with a full range of bandages, dressings, gloves, and first aid tools, it also includes a mountable bracket for easy storage and quick access inside vans, trucks, or fleet vehicles. Perfect for tradespeople, delivery drivers, and transport professionals to be prepared for emergencies while travelling.
b: Contents: Plasters (20), Tri Bandages / Fingerstalls / Pair Gloves / Tape (2), Safety Pins (12), Wipes (6), Lrg Dressing, Bandages 7.5cmx4m & 5cmx4m, Non-Adherent Dressings 5x5cm / Eye Wash (5), Tape
